{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-7","id":"msg_016qBPcsP5LiLXu8hRhfAz5s","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01LvWCJeUhASdnAcknxdxoPP","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/tmp/test_run.py","content":"import asyncio\nimport sys\nfrom run import run_tasks\n\n\nasync def test_basic():\n    \"\"\"Verify max_concurrent is respected and all tasks complete.\"\"\"\n    in_flight = 0\n    peak = 0\n    completed = []\n\n    def make_task(i):\n        async def t():\n            nonlocal in_flight, peak\n            in_flight += 1\n            peak = max(peak, in_flight)\n            await asyncio.sleep(0.05)\n            in_flight -= 1\n            completed.append(i)\n        return t\n\n    tasks = [make_task(i) for i in range(10)]\n    await run_tasks(tasks, max_concurrent=3)\n\n    assert peak == 3, f\"expected peak=3, got {peak}\"\n    assert sorted(completed) == list(range(10)), f\"missing tasks: {completed}\"\n    print(f\"basic: ok (peak={peak}, completed={len(completed)})\")\n\n\nasync def test_cleanup_on_cancel():\n    \"\"\"Verify finally blocks in tasks run when the outer coro is cancelled.\"\"\"\n    cleanups = []\n    started = asyncio.Event()\n\n    def make_task(i):\n        async def t():\n            try:\n                started.set()\n                await asyncio.sleep(10)\n            finally:\n                cleanups.append(i)\n        return t\n\n    tasks = [make_task(i) for i in range(5)]\n    runner = asyncio.create_task(run_tasks(tasks, max_concurrent=3))\n\n    await started.wait()\n    await asyncio.sleep(0.01)\n    runner.cancel()\n\n    try:\n        await runner\n    except asyncio.CancelledError:\n        pass\n\n    # The 3 that ran should have hit their finally blocks.\n    assert sorted(cleanups) == [0, 1, 2], f\"expected cleanups for [0,1,2], got {sorted(cleanups)}\"\n    print(f\"cleanup-on-cancel: ok (cleanups={sorted(cleanups)})\")\n\n\nasync def test_exception_propagates():\n    \"\"\"An exception in one task should cancel siblings (and let them clean up).\"\"\"\n    cleanups = []\n\n    async def boomer():\n        await asyncio.sleep(0.01)\n        raise ValueError(\"boom\")\n\n    def make_slow(i):\n        async def t():\n            try:\n                await asyncio.sleep(10)\n            finally:\n                cleanups.append(i)\n        return t\n\n    tasks = [boomer, make_slow(0), make_slow(1)]\n    try:\n        await run_tasks(tasks, max_concurrent=3)\n    except* ValueError:\n        pass\n\n    assert sorted(cleanups) == [0, 1], f\"expected siblings to clean up, got {sorted(cleanups)}\"\n    print(f\"exception-propagation: ok (siblings cleaned up: {sorted(cleanups)})\")\n\n\nasync def main():\n    await test_basic()\n    await test_cleanup_on_cancel()\n    await test_exception_propagates()\n    print(\"all tests passed\")\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    asyncio.run(main())\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":545,"cache_read_input_tokens":25611,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":545,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":52,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"8f61d244-a954-4068-83c1-bfe6e5651b85","uuid":"d0e52f1d-32ed-489d-a5f1-4c0e15004e48","request_id":"req_011CbAvLTbP4WRWCELWySsQX"}
